Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
We are looking for a Full Stack Developer with a solid foundation in software engineering and strong object-oriented programming skills. Your primary focus will be supporting the solutions of our Corporate Banking Team. You will work in an international environment and act as a trusted partner for both internal and external partners.
 Discover Raiffeisen Tech ✨ 
 Raiffeisen Tech Romania, a subsidiary of Raiffeisen Tech GmbH in Vienna, brings together experienced tech talents to enable Raiffeisen Bank International (RBI) Group to offer innovative technology solutions. The company fosters a collaborative environment for building international projects using advanced technologies, embracing a flexible approach and valuing curiosity and courage to innovate.
 Your mission 🎯
Develop, test, document Java-based software components
Conduct code reviews and security assessments
Plan and support releases
Work closely with Quality Assurance to ensure high quality of delivery
Bring a DevOps mindset to the full development lifecycle: coding standards, testing, documentation, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and security best practices
 Required superpowers 💪
Hands-on experience in development with Java, Angular
Strong object-oriented programming skills and familiarity with established design patterns
Prior experience with DB, PostgreSQL and other database tooling
Solid command of API technologies
Practical experience in Banking Business, in particular in cover pool management (mortgage and public, lending) and AI approach are a plus
Experience with Agile development methodologies and tools: Git, Jira, Jenkins
